description: 國光牌工業用油 ( Industrial oil )產品說明書 [oil fuels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣中油股份有限公司. 國光牌工業用油產 ( Industrial oil )品說明書提供工業機械如各類軸承、液壓系統、空氣壓縮機、蒸汽渦輪機、蒸汽機、水輪機、冷凍機、金屬切割工具機、金屬加工作業及防銹用潤滑之選擇和特性描述。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣中油股份有限公司. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-05-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
